scenes.text: Divide hundreds, then tens, then ones. Check every answer by multiplication.
Calculate 455 divided by 5. The answer is 91. 5 times 91 equals 455.
A club on a football field shares 450 pencils equally among 6 teams. How many per team? Pause to choose and explain.
A club on a football field shares 450 pencils equally among 6 teams. How many per team? The answer is 75. 6 times 75 equals 450.
